title: Cart Sheet
description:
This component is initially based on the Shopify standard.

## 🧑‍💼 User Story

**As an online shopper**,  
I want to view and manage my cart in an on-page overlay or side drawer (cart sheet)  
So that I can quickly:

* see which items I've added (including variant, quantity, stock status)
* apply discount codes
* understand potential savings (discount, free-shipping threshold)
* estimate shipping costs or tax
* checkout securely using my preferred payment method  
  without leaving the current page

---

enrichedData.purpose: Online shoppers need a convenient way to view and manage their cart without leaving the current page, including applying discounts, understanding costs, and proceeding to checkout.
useCases: Open cart sheet by clicking cart icon or Add to Cart button
View cart items with thumbnail, title, variant details, price, and subtotal
Adjust item quantity using increment/decrement controls or direct input
Apply discount codes and see updated totals
Track progress toward free shipping threshold
View cost breakdown with subtotal, discounts, shipping, tax, and total
Proceed to checkout with a prominent button
Add special instructions via cart attributes
